risk_if_not_implemented: Without Business Process Task Enumeration, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Reduced Operational Productivity (R-BC-3), Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Configuration Change Control
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to govern the technical configuration change control processes.
compensating_control_1.justification: Configuration Change Control (CHG-03) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Business Process Task Enumeration (AAT-43) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Business Process Task Enumeration (AAT-43) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
